ENCRYPTION ACTIVE

Your training data is strictly stored in your local neural vault (LocalStorage).

Local-First Storage

We do not use central servers for training logs. All performance metrics, heart rate estimates, and session history remain on your device.

AI Data Processing

When generating training roadmaps, your profile details are sent to the ZEPHYR AI engine via a secure uplink. No biometric photos or video streams are ever uploaded.

Anonymized Analysis

Your "Ring Name" and combat stats are used to personalize the AI coach's feedback, but they are never sold or shared with third-party advertisers.

The Kill Switch

Use the 'Reset Engine' option in the settings menu to immediately wipe all application data from your local system. Recovery is impossible once executed.
